_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `AssemblyMutation` is a semio-NATIVE vocabulary carried in `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio`, so no oracle is registered and the decision below records what stands in for one.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: No third-party library reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio` envelope, and none is authoritative over `AssemblyMutation` — a wave-function-collapse assembly graph whose vocabulary joins a slot lattice, an adjacency rule set and a per-module weight table under one `seed`, and whose diff is the only one in this plugin family that SPLITS every collection into a `<name>Removed`/`<name>Upserted` pair rather than a single delta record. That is this subset's own specification, not a fact an external solver or graph library could confirm or refute. Confidence comes instead from the committed specification vectors under `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/<kind>/🧪️tests/<fixture>/` — one handcrafted `(before, mutation, diff, outcome, after)` quintet per kind, already unit-tested inside the production crate — replayed end-to-end through the test platform here, plus two metamorphic laws asserted in role: observability (a kind must move the compared projection) and footprint completeness, which for this subset must resolve a snapshot field to EITHER of its two diff halves before it can decide anything.
